title: Public Bank wraps FY21 with RM5.66bil net profit, declares 7.7c div | The Star
text:
Public Bank wraps FY21 with RM5.66bil net profit, declares 7.7c div | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Public Bank Bhd recorded a net profit of RM5.66bil in the financial year ended Dec 31, 2021, a 16.11% improvement over RM4.87bil in the previous year.
The financial services group reported revenue of RM19.62bil which was slightly lower than RM20.3bil in 2020.
